Introduction

Dalshabet (also stylized as Dal★Shabet) is a six-member girl group, formerly under Happyface Entertainment. They were formed by producer duo E-Tribe and released their first mini album Supa Dupa Diva on January 4, 2011. They officially debuted on their stage on January 6 in their stage at M Countdown.
